title: EXODUS 14:14
THE LORD SHALL FIGHT
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: golden sun rays piercing dark clouds
solid rock fortress steep mountain cliff
serene high altitude snow peaks glowing

scenes.a: If that looming conflict makes your chest tighten right now, stay and seek shelter here.
Father, when the noise of accusation and the pressure of impossible circumstances surround us on every side,
we confess our human weakness and our tendency to fight battles we were never meant to carry alone.
Grant us the profound grace to step back from our striving and trust Your mighty arm to defend us.
Your holy word declares with absolute certainty:
The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
We rest securely in that promise today, resting beneath the shadow of Your unchanging wings. Amen.
